answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: a verifiable delay function per identity. To act each round, an identity outputs a VDF proof whose kernel is its key plus the beacon; the computation is inherently sequential, so no parallel hardware makes one finish faster. An attacker cannot fast-forward an orchard of fakes on one box: each clone needs its own sequential VDF in real time, so a thousand identities need a thousand parallel pipelines of elapsed time. Honest agents tick along on their own knoll; faking breadth costs wall-clock time, not a loop.
